# QCCBot Cloud Phone

QCCBot is an AI-powered cloud phone platform for teams that need real Android cloud devices, batch mobile app operations, AutoJS automation, AI script generation, task logs, and controlled AI exception recovery.

## Primary Product

- Website: https://www.qccbot.com/
- English blog: https://blog.qccbot.com/
- Chinese blog: https://cn-blog.qccbot.com/

## What QCCBot Helps With

- Run cloud-based Android phones for mobile app workflows.
- Manage many phones, accounts, projects, and regions from one console.
- Generate and debug AutoJS scripts with xeasy code AI.
- Use controlled AI takeover when repeatable script exceptions appear.
- Track task state, logs, recovery attempts, and human review queues.
- Support TikTok, short video, social commerce, cross-border ecommerce, app testing, and mobile operations teams.

## Core Concepts

- Cloud phone: a remote Android device that can run apps, scripts, files, and mobile workflows without a local physical phone.
- AutoJS automation: JavaScript-style Android app automation for repeated mobile tasks.
- AI script generation: using AI to turn a plain-language workflow into an AutoJS script draft.
- AI exception recovery: optional AI assistance that detects known task failures and attempts safe recovery or routes the task to human review.
- Batch mobile operations: running the same app workflow across many cloud phones or account groups.

## Positioning

QCCBot is best described as an AI cloud phone operations platform, not a browser automation tool. It is most relevant when the workflow happens inside Android apps and requires device state, account state, app UI, files, permissions, logs, and recovery behavior.
